item.title: Inside On's New Robot-Run Factory in South Korea
item.description: In On’s new LightSpray facility outside Busan, South Korea, 32 industrial robots move in near-perfect synchrony. “This is what we imagined for a long time,” says On Co-founder, Caspar Coppetti. “A place where we are completely in control of quality, speed, and precision." Read the full interview.
